title: Deconstructing span categories for profinite groups
summary: One of the major advantages of $\infty$-category theory over classical $1$-category theory is its robust and homotopically meaningful framework for taking (co)limits of diagrams of $\infty$-categories. However, it is both subtle and crucial to specify which variant of the $\infty$-category of $\infty$-categories is being used when forming such (co)limits. In this article, we present a concrete case study illustrating how (co)limits of $\infty$-categories behave in a specific setting.
